# PR #4076: Patch: daily super run failed

Closes #4035

This fixes every failed job of [super run 43777140858](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43777140858) that a bot can fix. The **daily tests** job also needs a person to edit `super.yml` after this merges. The exact lines are at the end.

## What changed, job by job

**fuzz (4/4): seed 9122 failed invariant I6.**
- **Cause:** a Rollback (R419) tried to put a face-down trap back into a lane a slash had voided (R3554002). The engine had already given the card a fresh id for going face-down (R227). The card never landed face-down, but it went to the hand under that new id. The opponent's earlier `exiled` event still named the old id, and nothing linked the two. With room in p2's hand, p1 could read the exiled card's id and def while that card sat hidden in p2's hand under another id.
- **Fix:** in `rebuild_sides` (`crates/engine/src/subsystems/board_history.rs`), a card the restore cannot place takes its own id back before it is bounced. `next_id` stays advanced.
- **Tests:** two new tests in `crates/engine/tests/rules/board_history.rs`, `mod r227_e29_a_restore_into_a_void_zone`. One covers the card going to hand, the other the card burned by a full hand. Both pass with the fix and both fail without it.

**daily tests (cancelled): the 60-minute timeout.**
- **Cause:** the pool grew to 799 cards, so the fuzz top-up test played 2,465 extra seeds in each of two waves. That is nearly two hours in the test profile.
- **Fix:** in `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`, `DAILY_TOP_UP_MAX` is now 300, about 15 minutes. `extra_daily_seeds` now reads `super.yml`'s `FUZZ_SEEDS` instead of the fixed 10,000. A pool past the cap now fails in under a second with "a person must widen FUZZ_SEEDS … to at least 12465" instead of timing out.
- **Still red:** this job stays red until a person makes the `super.yml` edit below.

**e2e (6/8): `56-board-notices-overlay.cy.ts` had never passed.** Four fixes:
- The seed is now `32-tribute-18`, which deals Right-house defender.
- The expected wording is now "summoning sick".
- The notice is cleared by picking up a hand card and putting it back, because an empty zone takes no click.
- p1 ends its turn before p2 offers a draw, because only the active player offers one (R36).

**e2e (8/8).** The planner could not reproduce this, but it fails on today's main: `17-card-showcase-and-hovers.cy.ts:523` expected Heroic Power (core-098) to cost `"0"`.
- **Cause:** #4044 (`1dc9cc542b`) raised the cost to 1. That commit came after the super run's `bcfdf80`, so it was not that run's 8/8 failure, but it would have failed the next run.
- **Fix:** the spec now reads the printed cost from `crates/cards/catalog.json`, as `support/busyBoard.ts` already does. `ci-scope.sh` needs no change, because a catalog change already turns e2e on.

**e2e component (1/3)** has two fixes:
- **card-faces:** the fused line-break test had been stale since R3941002, which prints the pair's two keyword lines as one. It now reads the three-ingredient `crafted` box.
- **arena-corners:** the test read the props before the first mount settled. It now waits, retrying, until both props are drawn.

**e2e component (3/3): `mobile-ux.cy.tsx` B29.** The test had been stale since #3973, and on phones the opponent's graveyard and exile pills had lost their tap area below.
- **CSS:** `apps/web/src/game/board.css`, phone block only. The opponent's pills' tap area reaches the full half of 44 px below again. That seat has no hand below it.
- **Test:** the probe stops halfway to a neighbouring target, as R2122000 says neighbours split the gap.

No patches fragment: `classify --claims` with main's build as the parent prints `classify: App` and exits 0.

## How I checked it

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo jackioh fuzz --from 9122 --seeds 1` | 1 passed, 0 invariant violations |
| `cargo jackioh fuzz --from 7501 --seeds 2500` (plain wave of 4/4) | 2500 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*'` | 2855 + 654 + 789 passed |
| `fuzz_daily_top_up` per-PR test | ok |
| Same test with `the_days_extra_seeds -- --ignored` | fails in under 1 s with the widen message |
| `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` | exit 0: 65 test binaries, 21,366 passed, 0 failed; `apps/web/src/wire` unchanged |
| `cargo fmt --check`; spec, catalog and patches checks | ok (spec check: 2220 rulings, 5630 proofs) |
| `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings` (with testkit) | clean |
| `classify --base origin/main --parent-bin <main's jackioh> --claims` | `classify: App`, exit 0 |
| Spec 56 alone | 3 of 3 viewports pass |
| Shard 6/8 on a fresh release server | 23 of 23 pass |
| Shard 8/8, first run | spec 17 failed at line 523 (the stale cost) |
| Shard 8/8 after the spec 17 fix, fresh server, `--config retries=0` | 44 of 44 pass |
| Component: arena-corners / mobile-ux / card-faces | 22 / 87 / 32 pass |
| eslint on the five specs; e2e `typecheck` and `typecheck:component` | ok |
| `vitest --project web --changed origin/main`, harness excludes | 145 files, 2995 tests pass on an idle machine |

A first vitest run, while the fuzz job held all four cores, failed 7 tests in 6 files. Those 6 files then passed 147 of 147 on the idle machine, and so did the full run above.

## Decisions the issue did not settle
- **No new ruling.** R227 already decides that only a card that actually goes face-down takes a fresh id.
- **Spec 17 reads the cost from the catalog** instead of hard-coding `"1"`. A restated number would break again with the next balance patch.
- **card-faces reads a different face.** I pointed the test at the `crafted` face rather than changing `fusedPair`, which would have changed the fit test's faces.
- **The phone CSS goes on top of #3973's change** rather than reverting it. A revert would bring back the overlaps #3973 fixed.
- **The fuzz coverage was kept.** Raising the top-up cap or lowering `DAILY_DEALS_PER_CARD` would have weakened it, so the extra seeds go into a wider `FUZZ_SEEDS` instead.

## Worth a second look
- **Spec 55 (`55-duos-2v2-lobby.cy.ts`) is flaky.** In the first run of shard 8/8 it failed its first attempt and passed on the retry. It then passed four times with retries off: alone three times, and in shard order on a fresh server. The next Cypress run cleared the screenshot before I read its error, so I have no root cause and changed nothing. It may be what failed the super run's 8/8 job, since that run's commit predates #4044. A person with log access should read [job 133008509702](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43777140858/job/133008509702) and open a follow-up if it names spec 55.
- **fx-phone-frame (component 3/3)** failed in planning only while the machine was heavily loaded and passed idle, so it has no change.
- **Replays:** the engine fix changes ids only on the rare path where a restored face-down card fails to land. The golden fold in `cargo test` and classify's cross-build check both pass.

## Needs a person (super.yml, after this merges)
Make these edits **after this PR merges**, not before: until then, the per-PR test still requires `FUZZ_SEEDS` to be at least 10,000.
- `.github/workflows/super.yml` line 84: `FUZZ_SEEDS: "10000"` → `FUZZ_SEEDS: "12500"`. The 799-card pool needs 12,465 seeds. 12,500 splits into four shards of 3,125, about 45 minutes each against the fuzz job's 90-minute timeout (estimated from local runs).
- Header line 6: "seeds 1-10,000" → "seeds 1-12,500".

After that the daily top-up plays nothing and the daily tests fit their budget.
